item.title: Apple Is Fighting for TSMC Capacity as Nvidia Takes Center Stage
item.description:
📝 TSMC’s revenue climbed 36% last year to $122 billion, it reported Thursday. In 2018 TSMC sales would have even fallen if not for incremental purchases by Apple that year. Smartphone revenue climbed just 11%, slower than 23% in the prior year.
🔗 Read more: https://www.culpium.com/p/exclusiveapple-is-fighting-for-tsmc

item.title: Show HN: TinyCity – A tiny city SIM for MicroPython (Thumby micro console)
item.description:
📝 TinyCity TinyCity is a city simulation game inspired by SimCity for the Raspberry Pi RP2040 running MicroPython Build and manage a growing metropolis in this tiny city sim. Balance zones and resources, hit milestones to gain bonuses and navigate disasters that are randomly generated. Features 3 terrains to choose from or a randomly generated map Residential, commercial, and industrial zoning Budget management Population growth & density, power grid, crime and pollution Disaster system with random events Milestones and hidden bonuses Save/load functionality Police & fire stations, power plants, stadiums, and more.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/chrisdiana/TinyCity

item.title: Nvidia Reportedly Ends GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Production, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB Next
item.description:
📝 ASUS shared exclusive information with Hardware Unboxed, revealing that NVIDIA has created a supply shortage for the GeForce RTX 5070 Ti, effectively ending its production. Yesterday's rumors also confirm that the regular RTX 5060 will be the priority card for NVIDIA going forward, for that segment. Fingers crossed that AMD doesn't follow suit.
🔗 Read more: https://www.techpowerup.com/345224/nvidia-reportedly-ends-geforce-rtx-5070-ti-production-rtx-5060-ti-16-gb-next

item.title: The 500k-ton typo: Why data center copper math doesn't add up
item.description:
📝 The claim from Nvidia suggests -- it's still on their website -- that the rack busbars in a single 1 gigawatt (GW) data center could require up to half a million tons of copper. The rack busbars alone in a single 1 gigawatt (GW) data center could require up to half a million tons of copper. The real bull case for copper remains compelling.
🔗 Read more: https://investinglive.com/news/the-500000-ton-typo-why-data-center-copper-math-doesnt-add-up-20260113/

item.title: French Court Orders Popular VPNs to Block More Pirate Sites, Despite Opposition
item.description:
📝 These VPN providers have to block access to several domains that provide access to pirated sports streams. The court concludes that these VPNs help people to bypass existing site-blocking measures, rendering ISP blocking ineffective. Therefore, a court order to block access only for French users would violate their contractual obligations.
🔗 Read more: https://torrentfreak.com/french-court-orders-popular-vpns-to-block-more-pirate-sites-despite-opposition/
